title: cd
description: Input schema for the litany built-in `cd` tool (ARCH §3.3 Working directory). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

path.description: The directory to move to. A relative path resolves against your current working directory; an absolute path is taken as given; `..` and symlinks are resolved, and the absolute result is what comes back. It must already exist and be a directory — a path that names nothing, or names a file, is declined and you stay where you were. The move persists: every later tool call of yours starts there, until you cd again.
